blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) have agreed on about 70 percent of the proposed Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea, but major issues remain unresolved as the year-end deadline for concluding negotiations approaches. DFA Asean spokesperson Dominic Xavier Imperial said Thursday that the remaining 30 percent still covers major issues being discussed by negotiators. Xavier declined to specify which provisions have yet to be settled.
